title: SOS: NON/multicast silent-drop branch untested
description: Found by codereview (edge pass) on b7z9.121.3. 所有 _expect_silent_drop 用例走 CON(empty ACK 分支);真实 LoRa/组播流量是 NON(messagemanager 的 no-ACK-pending 完全丢弃分支)无测试。补一个 NON(transport_tuning=Unreliable)或组播路径的静默丢弃断言。
close_reason: FIXED: added TestSosNonConfirmableSilentDrop to python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py covering the SOS silent-drop on the NON (non-confirmable) transport path — the branch every pre-existing _assert_silently_dropped case missed (they call render_post() directly, bypassing the message manager entirely; the CON-vs-NON divergence lives only in aiocoap's MessageManager). The test sends an unsigned SOS POST over the in-memory CoAP stack with transport_tuning=aiocoap.Unreliable (selects NON without the deprecated mtype= kwarg, mirroring the multicast test) and asserts the response future never resolves within 1.0s (pytest.raises(asyncio.TimeoutError) on wait_for(shield(fut))) — on NON a silent drop sends no response at all (no ACK to carry No-Response) — plus sos._active stays False. Tests: 116/116 pass (1 new); ruff check + format clean. 3x codereview ALL delegated to kimi-k3: correctness round-1 found the two direct-render NON tests were byte-for-byte duplicates providing zero NON-branch coverage (render_post never reads transport_tuning) — removed them, kept only the over-stack test; correctness round-2 PASS except a P4 docstring factual error (mis-described other tests as exercising the CON branch) — fixed; security PASS (oracle is two-pronged and cannot vacuously pass; NON premise backed by the positive multicast control); edge-cases PASS (1.0s window not flaky over call_soon fabric, shield/cleanup correct, no scheduling race). Both findings were defects in my own new test code, fixed inline during the loop.
